titles.title: absent catalog key → default written, path in filled
present + type-valid → carried unchanged; untouched subtrees referentially preserved
present + type-invalid → default substituted, path + discarded in repaired
falsy-but-valid values (false, 0, "") are carried, never filled (hasOwnProperty, not truthiness)
present array/object at a scalar row is detected as present (repaired), never filled
null at a non-nullable declared type is repaired, not carried
type-matching object with extra un-enumerated sub-keys is carried whole, no recursion to prune
catalog key reconciled beside a dynamic sibling at the same level — outcomes independent
partially-present ancestor chain: intermediates synthesized, only the leaf in filled, siblings untouched
ancestor segment collides with a scalar: subtree replaced, CATALOG path recorded in repaired with the discarded scalar
value already exactly equal to the catalog default → carried, not filled
changed === (filled + repaired + pruned > 0); changed false implies config deep-equals existing
non-object roots (undefined / null / array / string / number / boolean) → treated as {}, all keys filled
empty catalog + empty retired → changed false, config deep-equals existing
catalog row with an out-of-domain type throws ConfigCatalogError naming the path
catalog row whose own default fails its own declared type throws ConfigCatalogError naming the path
retired exact-path present → deleted, recorded in pruned[], changed true
retired exact-path absent → no-op, not in pruned, does not set changed
retired prefix root with populated subtree → whole subtree deleted, recorded ONCE as the prefix root
retired prefix root present as a SCALAR → slot removed, recorded (type-agnostic delete)
retired exact-path with falsy-but-present value (0/""/false) → pruned via hasOwnProperty, not truthiness
retired path with a MISSING ancestor → no-op, nothing recorded
un-catalogued key NOT on the retired list → preserved (blind-preservation refined)
idempotence with migrate + prune: reconcileConfig(reconcileConfig(x).config) is a no-op (real catalog + RETIRED_PATHS)
a retired path overlapping a live catalog row throws ConfigCatalogError naming the path
existing document is never mutated — a deep-frozen input reconciles+prunes and deep-equals itself afterwards
captured legacy config → migrated to the flat models.* surface, residue pruned, orphan survives
no user-config input produces a ConfigCatalogError against the real catalog + RETIRED_PATHS
